items.author: threataft
items.text: CVE-2026-58115 — CVSS 10.0, Node-RED on Siemens IoT2050. No authentication. One HTTP request drops a Linux bot or installs a webshell that survives reboot. Published August. Exploited October 30. Not in CISA KEV. VulnCheck confirmed attacks. Fix: update to Industrial OS V4.3.4.1, or uninstall Node-RED, or set adminAuth in settings.js. threataft.com/articles/cve-2026-58115-node-red-siemens-iot2050-
items.label: bear
